entries.en:
Nonotta and Riggy have prepared a complex conundrum for you and Jihli to solve as part of Hatching-tide. Nonotta also insists that you don the jacket she has designed especially for the event─which upon closer inspection you notice features an enormous hood complete with long, dangling attachments modeled after a spriggan's ears. It seems you will need to be attired to her satisfaction before she will allow you to begin the egg hunt.

※Please note that you will not be able to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, check the Lodestone.

entries.en: Clothed as Nonotta instructed, you submit yourself for her inspection. Though no explanation as to the supposed necessity of the garment is forthcoming, it at least serves the function of delighting her. She bids you go forth in search of three spriggans, who between them hold the key to unlocking the mystery she and Riggy have devised.
entries.fr: Vous voir porter la tenue du spriggan a ravi Nonotta. Trouvez vite les trois spriggans qui se cachent à Nouvelle Gridania pour obtenir les indices qu'ils détiennent !
entries.ja: ノノッタは、スプリガン衣装を着た冒険者を見て、満足したようだ。まずは、新市街にいるという3匹のスプリガンから情報を集めよう。

entries.en: Scouring the various nooks and crannies of New Gridania, you eventually locate the three spriggans, who are quick to give up their clues. They eagerly offer brief statements relating to the numbers one, two, and three, the meaning of which is for the most part unclear at this point. Meanwhile, Jihli stares intently at the map that Nonotta has provided, in the hope that the information you have gathered will help solve the Hatching-tide puzzle.

entries.fr: Vous avez parlé avec les trois spriggans vernis, qui vous ont chacun confié un chiffre : “un” pour celui de la guilde des archers, “deux” pour celui du Verger de faines et “trois” pour le spriggan du ruisseau du Thé noir. Rejoignez Jihli au Nœud pour partager ces informations avec elle.
entries.ja: 3匹のスプリガン・エッガーと話した。弓術士ギルド前にいたスプリガン・エッガーは、数字の「1」について話していた。どんぐり遊園にいたスプリガン・エッガーは、数字の「2」について話していた。紅茶川にいたスプリガン・エッガーは、数字の「3」について話していた。水車四辻で「ジリ・アリアポー」と合流しよう。

entries.en: Now that the necessary pieces are ostensibly in place, Nonotta divulges the password─Egg Hunt─which presumably will lead you to the gilded tourmaline egg when uttered in the correct location. Whether you and Jihli are able to find the place in question is another matter, as the small problem of unraveling the many-layered enigma yet remains.

entries.en: You cleverly deduce that Mother Miounne is the one charged with safeguarding the gilded tourmaline egg, and she relinquishes your prize as per her agreement with Nonotta. The item in question is rather colorful, and a slight rustling sound comes from inside when it is shaken. You and Jihli decide that rather than quibbling over the object's true nature, you should return it to Nonotta and Riggy and put their puzzle to bed.
entries.fr: Miounne a réagi lorsque vous avez donné le mot de passe, et vous a remis . La teinte n'est pas tout à fait celle que vous cherchiez, mais vous ne pouvez pas vous être trompé. Remettez-le à Nonotta, au Nœud.

entries.en: Nonotta praises you and Jihli for having overcome the challenge she had posed, or at least the first part of it. She wastes no time in revealing that this was merely a precursor, and the true conundrum is yet to come. The source of the rustling from inside the gilded tourmaline egg turns out to be another map, filling Jihli with a great sense of apprehension that her cognitive abilities will be pushed to their limits and beyond. Only time will tell if yours are up to the task.

entries.en: So, you think you've found the answer? You'll still need to use the password, though. It's “Egg Hunt” in case you forgot!
entries.fr: Le mot de passe, c'est “Chasse aux Prœufs” ! En le disant à proximité de l'endroit où se trouve notre œuf, il devrait se passer quelque chose !
entries.ja:
飾りタマゴを受け取るための合言葉は、「エッグハント」です！
タマゴの隠し場所付近で言うことで、何かが起こるはずですぅ～！

entries.en: Yes, finding the gilded tourmaline egg was only the beginning! For inside it is...another map! This time, the prize you seek is a gilded topaz egg.
entries.fr: ... Juste que je vous ai bien  ! Il y avait un autre papier dans l'œuf que vous m'avez apporté, hi hi hi ! Vous n'avez pas trouvé sa teinte bizarre ? Vous n'avez même pas cherché à l'ouvrir ? Pfff... Élucidez cette nouvelle énigme et rapportez-moi ce que je vous ai demandé, hi hi hi !

entries.en: Oh dear... I thought I had already surpassed the limits of my mental faculties. If these puzzles get any more difficult, I fear my head shall explode!
entries.fr: Ces deux-là, on ne pourrait pas les accuser de faire le travail à moitié... Mais pas le temps de nous extasier sur leurs efforrrts. On a un mystère à démêler et un Prœuf à dégoter !!
entries.ja:
ノノッタちゃん、まさかここまでやるなんて……！
でもでも、絶対に謎を解いて、
次の飾りタマゴも見つけてみせましょう！
